title: Judge: City may have violated Westcott Theater's First Amendment rights
summary: A state Supreme Court judge ruled Monday that the City of Syracuse may have violated the Westcott Theater's First Amendment rights through its closure of the venue last month. The court is requesting additional evidence from the city to justify the closure decision. This ruling introduces potential legal and constitutional liability for the city regarding its enforcement actions against a cultural institution.
